text.title: Laravel Umbrella Failure Modes
text.summary: 8 antipatterns observed in real Laravel 10/11 production deployments — four operational, four in how the framework itself is used. Each pairs symptom + root cause + concrete fix.

antipattern.symptom: Endpoint latency spikes whenever a "background" job fires; CPU saturates the web pod under load.
antipattern.root-cause: `QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync` in production env executes jobs inline on the request thread.
antipattern.fix: Switch to `redis` (with Horizon) or `sqs`. Run `php artisan queue:work` under Supervisor. Verify via `php artisan queue:monitor`.

antipattern.symptom: Secrets leak to public GitHub mirror; access tokens revoked emergency at 03:00.
antipattern.root-cause: `.env` accidentally committed; `.gitignore` did not cover it.
antipattern.fix: Add `.env` + `.env.*` to `.gitignore`. Rotate all secrets. Store production secrets in 1Password / Vault and template into `.env` at deploy time.

antipattern.symptom: Scheduled tasks stop running silently after the worker crashes; no alert fires.
antipattern.root-cause: `php artisan schedule:work` ran in a tmux session; the host rebooted; process never restarted.
antipattern.fix: Run scheduler + queue workers under Supervisor with `autostart=true`, `autorestart=true`. Add a heartbeat job that pings dead-man's-snitch.

antipattern.symptom: Production runs on PHP 7.4; security patches stopped landing two years ago.
antipattern.root-cause: Composer `require` floor too low; deploys never enforced.
antipattern.fix: Set `"php": "^8.2"` in `composer.json`. Enforce via CI matrix that fails on lower versions.

antipattern.symptom: Local works; production crashes reading a null credential immediately after `php artisan config:cache`.
antipattern.root-cause: `env('STRIPE_KEY')` is called inside a service class rather than in `config/*.php`; only config files run before the cache is frozen.
antipattern.fix: Move the call into `config/stripe.php` (`return ['key' => env('STRIPE_KEY')];`) and read `config('stripe.key')` in the service, per `env-secrets-not-config-cache-leak`.

antipattern.symptom: Every test needs `Mail::fake()`, `Queue::fake()`, `Storage::fake()`; `setUp()` is 30 lines of fake registration and unit tests boot the whole framework.
antipattern.root-cause: Services call facades directly, so substituting a double requires Laravel's fake registry.
antipattern.fix: Refactor the service to constructor-inject contracts (`MailService`, `CacheService`) per `constructor-injection-over-facades`; unit tests then use plain PHPUnit mocks.

antipattern.symptom: `php artisan route:cache` fails with a closure-not-serializable error, so the deploy ships without the route cache.
antipattern.root-cause: A route is defined as an inline closure with `use ($variable)`; closures cannot be serialised.
antipattern.fix: Convert every route to a controller method reference — `Route::get('/', [HomeController::class, 'index'])` — per `routes-in-route-files-only`.

antipattern.symptom: A binding only resolves after one specific endpoint has been hit; the first request after a deploy fails with an unresolvable contract.
antipattern.root-cause: `app()->bind(MailService::class, ...)` sits inside a controller, so it never runs at boot.
antipattern.fix: Move the binding into a Service Provider's `register()` and register the provider, per `contract-bind-in-provider`.
